name: Subhan Ahmed
intro:
Engineer. UI purist. Probably over-engineered this too.
From backends to pixels, I care how all of it feels.
shortDescription: Software engineer with a bias for craft, building across the stack with deep roots in Flutter and a growing focus on backend systems and AI integration. I've shipped 7+ production apps across healthcare, education, and social platforms, architecting complex systems end to end, from real-time BLE monitoring and fraud prevention to AI powered mobile experiences. My background is mobile first, my ambition is full stack, and my standards don't shift.
